uniform ellipticity
unit direction l

exact_statement: For the two-type iid UE law on Z^2 with A=(7/10,1/10,1/10,1/10), B=(1/10,7/10,1/10,1/10), and A-mass a>7/8, every finite-domain auxiliary e1 drift is at least delta(a)=(3/5)(a-7(1-a))/(a+7(1-a)). At a=9/10 this is 3/40, so the preceding sufficient-condition argument gives deterministic ballistic velocity v with v.e1>=3/40.
assumptions: two-dimensional nearest-neighbor site-iid law as specified
a>7/8; a=9/10 for the numeric bound
kappa=1/10
no novelty claim for the standard Kalikow-style argument
